on_screen_text.text: Zohran Mamdani RIPS into Trump's 'Big Beautiful Bill'

spoken_summary: Zohran Mamdani delivers a speech criticizing legislation passed by Donald Trump, which he sarcastically calls the "so-called Big Beautiful Bill." He argues it was the "greatest wealth transfer in American politics," designed to enrich billionaire donors. Mamdani claims the bill will remove healthcare from millions of New Yorkers and cut SNAP benefits for the hungry. The crowd boos in disapproval when the bill is mentioned.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of a man's speech delivered to a live audience, which can be heard booing in response at certain points. The speaker's voice has natural reverb from the large room. There is no background music or other sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is presented as a single, static wide shot with no cuts or camera movement. On-screen text captions appear and disappear to match the speech.
central_claim: Donald Trump's signature legislation was a massive transfer of wealth to billionaires that harms working people by cutting their healthcare and food benefits.
intended_effect: To provoke anger towards Donald Trump and his wealthy supporters, framing their policies as a direct attack on working-class people.
